tinyfish.note: TinyFish hosted MCP server. Requires OAuth 2.1: on first connection you are prompted to sign in to your TinyFish account in the browser — there is no API key to paste. Tools this plugin uses: search and fetch_content (both free), run_web_automation and run_web_automation_async for goal-driven multi-step automation (including logged-in sites via use_profile and use_vault), get_run and cancel_run, and create_browser_session for CDP control from Playwright or Puppeteer.
